messages.subject: Scheduled DMS maintenance — Saturday 22 November
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system (NetDocuments) will be unavailable from 20:00 to 23:00 on Saturday 22 November for scheduled maintenance. Please save and check in any open documents beforehand. Email and calendar are unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
